class.name: NetwPersistenceConfig
class.brief_description: Which record of which [NetwDatabase] an entity loads and saves.
class.description:
Each column of [method schema] is filled by one property marked with [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted]. A column with no property refuses the whole entity. Configure it from [method Node._ready], where the node is in the tree. [codeblock] func _ready() -> void: Netw.configure_property(self, &"position", false) \ .persisted(game.save_schema.column_ref(0)) Netw.configure_persistence(self) \ .database(&"saves") \ .schema(game.save_schema) \ .record_id(account_name) \ .interval(5.0)
func account_name() -> StringName: return entity.entity_id [/codeblock] Use a [method record_id] that stays the same between sessions. A peer id changes every time the player joins. The record is reached through [member NetwEntity.persistence].

method.name: database
method.description: Names the [NetwDatabase] this entity's record lives in, as [method Netw.configure_database] declared it.

method.name: interval
method.description: Saves the record every [param seconds] when something changed. [code]0.0[/code] saves only when you call [method NetwPersistenceHandle.save]. [b]Server Only.[/b]

method.name: load_on_spawn
method.description: Whether the server loads the stored record when the entity's node is ready. Clients do not receive the entity until the load succeeds or finds no record. Call [method NetwPersistenceHandle.load] to retry a failed load.

method.name: record_id
method.description: Sets the function that returns the id this entity's record is stored under. It is called once and must return a nonempty [StringName].

method.name: schema
method.description: Sets the [NetwSchema] of this entity's record. Every [NetwColumnRef] passed to [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] must come from this schema.
